tei:div.tei:p: (375)༄༅// 1$0000270'od gsal snying gi theg le'i dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi smin byed ye shes mchog stsol bzhugs/ (376)

ngag la ngag gi dbang thob pas// dpal ldan yon tan bye bas phyug /mkhas btsun bzang po'i khyu mchog che// 'gro ba'i bla ma de la 'dud// de yi zhal lung bdud rtsi'i skyes// mchog thun grub pa'i sgo gcig pu// dbang drag rdo rje gro lod kyi// smin byed ye shes mchog stsol bri// gang du bya ba'i gnas su ras bris khro dkyil rta babs brgyad ma/ khyams gru chad/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rnams phyogs mdog zla gam dmar po/ chos 'byung mthing gar lha gnas sku'am phyag mtshan thig le bris pa'i dbus mañdzi'i khar dpal gtor brjid ldan dmar po/ thebs kyu lha grangs/ sku tsag dang dar gdugs mthing kas brgyan pa/ thod chang chos sman mngar gsum sbyar ba/ sman rag gtor gsum/ phyi nang mchod pas (377) bskor ba dang*/ dkar bgegs/ chad brtan tshogs kyi yo byad rnams dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du/ nang mchod/ rdor dril/ thod rnga/ las bum/ nas ze/ thun snod sogs kyanga'adu bya/ dngos gzhi la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du song nas/ dkar bgegs mtshams bcad/ skyabs sems nas bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas dang*/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis brlab/ bka' srung tshogs bsgral bstab yan zin nas/ bdag nyid 'jug pa 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin nam sgyu 'phrul ltar rig pa'i me tog dor/ gnang ba nod/ slob ma rnams sgo khar khrus nas dbyung*/ nang du zhugs nas bgegs la gtor ma sbyin nas bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ me tog bskyed bsdu dang (378) chos bshad mtshams sbyor rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa las/ skabs su babs pa 'di ni mkha' 'gro snyig tig las/ gsal rje gangs kyi shar phyogs ngos: lcags sgrom lta bu'i yul gyi stod: 'brong bu nyal 'dra'i spyi steng du: mkha' 'gro sde lngas byin brlabs pa'i: sa khams yos lo ngag gi dbang : spro ring theg chen chos la mos: sbas tshul 'khor ba'i cha 'dzin zhing :

ma 'gags spyod pa sna tshogs spyod: ces dang*/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ lan gcig ma 'ongs dus kyi tha mang yang : gsang ba'i mtshan 'dzin bzang po'i ming can dag: dgongs 'dus thugs sras yang dag mchog don ldan: yos lo lte sme lha sras (379)bla ma'i tshul: bstan pa'i srung skyob 'gro ba mang zhig 'dren: gsang sngags nges don thabs lam gnad dang ldan: bstan pa 'gro don lho nas lho ru dar: dgongs 'dus bka' chen lung gi bdag por gyur: zhes dang*/ rat+na'i gter lung las/ klu sgrub sprul pa bstan pa'i bdag nyid 'dzin: bzang po'i ming can glang ngam yos lo pa: bstan la phan pa khams kyi phyogs su 'byung : zhes rdo rje'i lung gis yang nas yang du bsngags pa'i skyes pa rabs kyi phreng ba yang*/ dam pa'i rigs can drwa ma lnga las lo tsā ba dri med grags pa dge slong blo 'chang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub ste ston pa'i lung zin gsum/ zla ba grags pa/ chos kyi grags pa/(380)blo gros brtan pa ste 'phags yul mkhas pa gsum/ 'jag dpal bshes gnyen/ hūm̐ chen kā ra/ bi ma la ste rnal 'byor dbang po gsum/ cog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan/ nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po/ gnubs chen nam mkha'i snying po ste bod yul lo tsā' gsum/ rgyal po rnam gnon/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ bstan pa tshe ring ste chos kyi rgyal po gsum/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/ go ram bsod nams seng ge/ mkhas btsun ye shes 'bum pa ste bod yul mkhas pa gsum/ mnga' bdag nyi ma 'od zer/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ grub thob karma gling pa te rig 'dzin gter ston gsum/ rje btsun (281)rat+na ma ti/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug mkhas grub karma chags med de bya bral rnal 'byor gsum sogs mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug gcig dang du ma'i 'phrul gyis skye ba'i phreng bar bzung zhing*/ sku tshe 'dir yang mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod/

btsun pa'i yon tan/ (grub pa'i yon tan ) grub pa'i mngon rtogs/ mdzad pa'i phrin las sogs phyogs sgo mo nas lhun gyis grub cing*/ khyad par paṇa chen bi ma la lo brgya re'i mtshams su bod la byon pa'i mngon rtags shangs rtser a yig gis mtshan pa kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa song ngo*/ mtshar ba'i rnam thar brjod las 'das pa kun mkhyen bla ma (382)ngag gi dbang po dpal bzang po'i 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying gi thig le'i chos skor babs pa cung zad gtan la phab pa ste/ rang gzhung las/ 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas bka': 'jigs med gling pa'i chos sde yin: de dus brda 'di ma pheb bzhag: zhing skyong lha mor gnyer gtad nas: ma 'ongs snying ma bdo ba'i dus: nga yi rjes 'dzin nga yi bu: rig pa hur la btul zhugs can: rang byung gdings dang ldan pa'i dbus: brda grol 'gro la sman gyur shog: da dus shing sbrul dkar po'i mjug: bstan zhabs (383)sdud pa'i he ru yi: snyigs ma'i rlung nag g.yos pa'i dus: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul yig gi: brda 'di zhing skyong lha mos bstan: brda 'grel las kyi rdo rjes so: zhes gsungs pa'i nang tshan che mchog pad+ma drag po dbang chen rdo rje gro bo lod kyi skor te/ de'ang phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba ma lus pa'i thugs rje nus mthu mdzad phrin yon tan thams cad gcig bsdus su byin gyis brlabs nas 'gro ba'i 'dren par mngags pa gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes sku gsum ston pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtshor mtshan dang sku'i rnam 'gyur gcig tu ma nges shing sna tshogs (384)sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol mos 'khor ba ji srid de srid du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa las/ zhing 'dir yongs su grags pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi ya gyal/ legs sbyar skad du kro dha lo korta ra ste khro bo 'jig rten mchog ces 'jig rten gyi khams na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i ye shes kyi khro rgyal chen po'i skur bstan pa/

sgra de zur chag pa'i nges don mdo sngags zung 'jug gi sku'i chas las rdo rje gro bo lod de 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen po 'di ni/ slob dpon chen pos thog mar bsam yas kyi sa gzhi 'dul ba'i skabs dang*/ bar du bdud blon rnams kyis sku la tho btsams pa'i dus dang*/ mthar (385)rnga yab pad+ma 'od du gshegs khar mon spa gro stag tshang seng ge phug pa sogs khams bod kyi stag tshang ming can bcu gsum du rdo rje gro lod rtsal gyi skur bzhengs nas mi dang mi ma yin gdug cing gtum pa thams cad tshar bcad cing rjes su bzung nas dam la bzhag pas mtshon/ bod yul gyi gdul bya mi srun pa rnams 'dul ba'i sku'i bkod pa ni 'di kho nar bstan pa shas che ste/ rang gzhung las/ sil ma dang 'u yug mal gro klung*/ has po ri dang sham po mkha' ri dang : ti se gangs dang mchims phu shel brag dang : mkhar chu bsam yas khra 'brug la sogs dang :(386)khyad par stag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub ta: dpal chen rdo rje gro lod skur bstan te: bod yul mtha' dag gter gyis gtams byas nas: zhes dang*/ gter kha gzhan las kyang*/ e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: rang gi sgrub pa rang gis brtsams: su 'phrad bde chen zhing la sbyor: zhes dang*/ khyad par byin rlabs dngos grub myur 'dod na: rdo rje drag rtsal pad+ma nga nyid bsgom: dus gsum sangs rgyas yon tan bdag la rdzogs: rgyal ba zhi khro gsang sngags phyi nang dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dngos grub rnams: nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod kun tshang ltar: de dag thams cad ma lus (387)bdag la rdzogs: nga nyid bsgom dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang : rgyal ba sras bcas de la gzigs: gsang sngags phyi nang lha tshogs thams cad kyis: dbang bskur byin brlab dngos grub ster bar byed: ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad sprin ltar 'dus: bka' srung chos skyong thams cad bran ltar nyan: snang srid lha 'dre thams cad bka' bzhin sgrub:

yon tan thams cad nga nyid bsgom las 'byung : dngos grub thams cad nga nyid bsgom pas thob: phrin las thams cad nga nyid bsgom pas 'grub: ces dang*/ bdud 'dul gro lod las/ ma 'ongs nga yi rjes 'jug kun: 'di nyid (388)nyams su sus blangs pa: 'jig rten dregs pa ma lus 'dul ba dang : khyad par rgyal bsen dam sri thams cad dang : 'jig rten log gshed bdud rigs ma lus kun: srog snying phul zhing bran du khol: bka' nyan gsung sdod byed par 'gyur: mngon sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu thob: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i gang zag kun: skad cig tshe 'di nyid la ni: dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: rig 'dzin sa la ma 'god na: pad+ma nga yis phyi rabs skal ldan bslus pa yin: de phyir nyams su longs shig nga yi rjes 'jug kun: 'on kyang dus ngan sems can las ngan dbang che bas: sbyangs pa sngon song skal (389) ldan re 'ga' tsam re ma gtogs pa: 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i skyes bu shin tu dka': dper na me tog u dum+bā ra dag dang mtshungs: yang zab 'di nyid 'phrad pa'i skyes bu shin tu dkon: dper na nyin mo'i skar ma dag dang mtshungs: 'di nyid sgrub mchod sus byed pa: pad+ma nga nyid dngos nyid (yin )pad+ma'i bka': 'jig rten dregs pa ma lus 'dul ba dang: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang : tshe 'dir rig 'dzin sa la 'god 'dod na: snying thig zab mo 'di nyid nyams su longs: snying thig 'di 'dra 'jig rten gsum na dkon: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: dkon med rgyal (390)khams 'grim dang gsal: zhes phan yon mtha' klas pa mnga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di nyid du smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba la sogs mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can: srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyang ba: de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter: gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol: lan gsum/

rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ bshags yul mkha' khyab tu sad pa'i spyan sngar gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang bas/ hoḥ dbang chen rdo rje gro lod dgongs su gsol: ma rig rmongs pas ldong ba'i skye 'gro dang : rnal 'byor dam la gnas pa'i sgrub pa po: thog ma med pa'i dus nas da bar 'khor: gzung 'dzin chags (391)pa'i dbang gis bsag pa yis: rgyud drug bag chags ji snyed ma lus dang : rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams: rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes bshags pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/ so byang sngags kyi dam chig spyi dang khyad par lhag pas bsdus pa thams cad bsrung bar dam bca' ba ni/ hoḥ ma rig rlabs kyas sames nying rang zhal bsgrib: ye nas dbyer med rtog pas so sor bzung ཿ rang byung 'du 'bral med pa'i rdo rje sems: sku gsung thugs su bsgub par dam bca' 'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ha yoḥ de nas ye (392) shes dbab pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsu gyi gnad gcun pas lha bskyed yongs rdzogs bton te gsal 'debs pa phyag bzhes su mdzad la/ tshig lhug pas gsal gdab na/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngag las yi ge hūm̐ yig dmar po pad+ma ra ga ltar 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nag du nam mkha' rlung khrag keg rus pa gzhi ri rab me ri dang bcas pa'i khar/ rdo rje me dpung dur khrod pad+masan tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar dbang drag rol pa'i gzhal med khang*/ phyi rin po che dang nag bhanyadza las grub pa grub bzi sgo bzhi rta babs brgyad ldan chos 'akor ri dwags gdug pa dag bcas pa/ dbus phyur bu rdo rje rin po che'i tog tshad dang mtshan (393)nyi ma tshang ba med pa/ rgyan dag bkod pa phun yum tshogs pas brgyan pa/ nang bar khyams gru chad 'khor lo rtsib bzhi lte ba chos 'byung 'bar bar/

sna tshogs pad zla nyi ma bdud dang dam sri bsnol ba'i steng du dmu stag mi zan shin tu 'jigs pa'i gdan la/ 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen po dbang drag khros pa rdo rje gro bo lod sku mdog mthing nag baidūr sngon po'i ri rab nyi ma bye bas 'khyud pa lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhal ang gtsig sdom zhing mche ba gtsigs pa'i ljags las 'od zer 'phro ba/ spyan gsu las bskal me 'bar zhing smin glog ltar 'khyug pa/ shangs (394)mtshon cha'i bu yugs 'tshubs pa/ ag tshom sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ ral pa khams nag rdo rje'i tshom bu 'khyil ba las me rlung 'phro ba/ snyan cha ngur long rdo rje'i khog gseng las 'brug sgra sgrogs shing rdo rje'i thog char 'bebs pa/ ber phyams dmar smug chos gos dmar po rnam pa gsum gyis krubs pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje ce lnga gnam lcags ral gri 'bar ba las rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ g.yon lcags phur 'dril pa las lcags sdigs nag po sor ltar 'bebs pa/ zhabs sag l+h+wam dang bcas pa'i dor stabs kyas stag me'i mgo dang 'phang steng brjadzis pa/ 'bar (395)ba'i gur dgu dang ldan pa/ thus kar zla gam dmar po'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa' pad+ma he ru ka dbu lnga pa/ g.yas dkar g.yon ser rgyab ljang steng mthing sku dag rtsa zhal dmar ba zal re re bzhin rta mgo ljang zhur/ zhur dkar po/ phum phum ser po rgog ma dmar po las bzhi'i mdog can 'tsher ba/phyag bcu drag gi g.yas pa brgyad na/ rdo rje/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ dril bu/ lcags kyu sbrul zhags/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ rdo rje'i zhags pa/ g.yon pa brgyad na/ thod khrag pad+ma/ ru tra'i snying*/ rdo rje'i dbyug pa/ rgya gram/ be con/ me dpung*/ tri shu la dang ye shes kyi khyung khra 'gyed pa (396)rdo rje'i khyungagashog rtse na khyung dang nyi zlas mtshan pa/ dur khrod dpal gyi chas rnams rdzogs pa zhabs brgyad g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyi 'gying ba'i sang du yum pad+ma gzi ldan mthing ga nor bu za ma tog bsnams pa dang sbyor ba/

gtso bo'i dbu gtsug tu budha thod phreg rtsal dmar smug/ rtsibs bzhi'i shar du badz+ra thod phreng rtsal dkar po/ lhor rat+na thod phreng rtsal ser po/ nub tu pad+ma thod phreng lnga'i phyag rgya/ pod ka cod pan dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa rdo rje'i skyil krung pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la (397)bzhugs pa/ gru chad bzhir rigs bzhi'i ging chen las bzhi'i mdog can rang rtags dang bhan+dha/ gsang ba'i yum bzhi gri thod 'dzin cing gcer bu rin chen rusapas brgyan pa pad+ma bam rong gar stabs su 'gying ba/ bar khyams su gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro 'bul khrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang*/ sgo bzhir sgo skyong phyag rgya bzhi ldan rgyal chen pho nyar 'gyed pa/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu du bzhi'i de bzhin gshes pa sras dang (398)bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thams cad kyang dbang chen rdo rje gro lod dkyil 'khor pa'i sku phyag rgya/ gsung sngags phreng*/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin spyan drangs te snying ga nas sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i

mos pas/ las byang gi sapayan 'dren nam byin 'bebs tshig dang*/ rtsa sngags mthar/ oṃ dzñā na a be sha ya a āḥ sogs b.rod pas byin dbab/ de brtan pa'i phyir/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ dngos gzhi la maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ phung po khams dang skye mchod tshogs: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: sku gsung thugs su dag sbyor bas: phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig: (399) de nas gtor ma la dbang ba la/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer rim par byung te gnas gsum du thim pa dang*/ khyad par gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pas snod bcud dkyil 'khor gyi loye nas gzhir bzhugs su gyur pa gzhir bzhengs su gsal 'debs pas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bh+rum̐ skyes gtor ma lha yi gzhal yas khang : yid 'ong rab tu mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan: bcud kyi dam rdzas gtso bo thabs shes dang : mtheb kyu 'khor tshogs sprul pa ging gi tshogs: skal ldan bu la gtor mas dbang bskur bas: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku: sku yi byin brlabs slob ma'i lus la zhugs: bde ba chen (400)po lus la dbang bskur bas: na tsha sdug bsngal 'akrul pa'i snang zhen sbyang : oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya: nirma ṇa kā ya bha ling ta a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ des lus kyi las dang rtsa yi sgribs pa dag: sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs: bum pa'i dbang thos: bskyed rim gyi snod du gyur: rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs: sprul ku'i go phangs thob pa'i skal pa rgyud la bzhag go: gtor ma mgrin par bzhag cig bdad rtsi sbyinan pas 'byu ba'i rlung khams mtha' dag grags stong sngags kyi 'khor lo rdzogs par mos pas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bde gshegs yab yum sbyor ba'i byang chub sems: dri med bdud rtsi gsang ba'i dbag chen po: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgyal ba (401)'dus pa'i gsung : gsung gi byin brlabs slob ma'i ngag la zhugs:

rmad byung mi shigs gsung gras dbang bskur bas: sgra skad zhen rtogs sngags la dbang bsgyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya: saṃ bh+yo ga kā ya: bha ling ta a bhi ṣiñtsad ā: de'i rjes 'brel du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags phreg byung slob ma'i mgrin pa nas zhugs snying gar 'khor bar/ mos pas bsnyen sgrub sgas rnams rjes zlos bya/ des ngag gi las dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag: gsung rdo rje'i byin brlabs zhugs: gsang ba'i dbang thobaḥ bzlas brjod kyi snod du gyur: tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs: longs spyod rdogs sku'i gong 'phangs kyi skal ba gyud ma bzhag: gtor ma rnying gar bzhag pas khams 'bar 'jag la brten (402)pa'i zhu bde lhan cig skyes pala'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar mos pas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang bzhin lhun gyi gub pa'ado gsal ba: 'pho 'gyur med pa ye nas rgyal ba'i thugasaḥ rmad byung gtor ma shes rab ye shes dbang : dus gsu bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i thugs: skal ldan slob ma'i sems dal dbang bskur bas: sems kyi 'khrul rtog 'od gsal chen por dag: skye 'chi med pa'i ting 'dzin mchog la sbyor: sku gsum rtogs pa 'bar ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya: dharma kā ya:bha lig ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: dpe yid kyi las dag thig le'i sgribs pa dag: thugs rdo rje'i byin brlabs zhugs: shes rab (403)ye shes kyi dbang thob: bde stog tsaḍ+ḍa li'i snod du gyur: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'din gyi sa bon thebs: chos sku'i go 'apang thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag: gtor ma gnas gsu du bzhag pas thugs rgyud gongs pa'i byin chen snying dbus su sbra ba'i yog pas/ hūm̐: tshad med rmad byung thugs rje'i gtor ma 'di: dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu rin po che: dbang gi rgyal po dngos grub sgrub pa'i rten: mi zad sku gsung thugs skyi dngos grub stsol:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: dag pa'i lhar snang 'od gsal du bsdus pas byung tshor gyi spros pa 'gags pa'i rig pa rang gnas kyi ye shes mngon du 'char ba ngo shes pas/ hūm̐: ngo mtshar sprul pa'i 'khor lo ma (404)lus pa: ma skyes sems kyi dkyil 'akor che por thim: chos rnams rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi ngang : ye shes lnga rdzogs stong nyid dam pa'i mdzod: a a a: zhes dgongs pa bskyangs/ des kun gzhi'i las dang shes bya'i sgribs pa dag: ye shes rdo rje'i byin brlabs zhugs: tshig gis tshon sa don dom gyi dbang thob: ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gyur: lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi sa bon theb: mthar thug gi 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag go: shis brjod/ dam tshig khas blangs bzhi/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs mchog dang : ུna lag dam tshig nyi shu lnga : med dang gcig pu phyal ba sogs: cho ga bsrung bar bgyi: gtang (405)(406)rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus longs spyod ba ma'i phyogs su gtong ba/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa: de dag thams bad bgis bgyi: khyed la bdag kyang yongs su 'bul: slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol: dge ba bsango la slob ma rang gnas su btang*/ tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btang ba man spyi ltar ro/ las kun grub pa gtor ma'i dbang bzhi la/ brten nas sad rmi gnyid 'thug snyoms 'jug gi/ bag chags sbyong te lam bzhis rig 'dzin bzhi/ bsgrod nas sku bzhi'i go 'phangs myur thob shog zhes lam zab 'di nyid kyi chos sgo thog mar 'byed pa'i smod ldan du gyurapa rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus la rtsal gyis kun mkhyen bla ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel//
